justification: Inspected the exact-package files `Validators.java`, `Validator.java`, `ProblemReporter.java`, `SimpleValidator.java`, `TypedValidator.java`, `SingleNodeTypeValidator.java`, `TreeVisitorValidator.java`, `VisitorValidator.java`, `ReservedKeywordValidator.java`, and `RecordAsTypeIdentifierNotAllowed.java`. The package contains only 10 classes and 505 total LOC, with the largest files at 65 LOC; most types are small abstractions or wrappers, and the version-specific validation logic is split into subpackages (`language_level_validations` has 42 files, `postprocessors` has 17 files) instead of being centralized here, so this package does not look like an excessively large God Component.
